query: What is Ayushman Bharat and what does it cover?
key_facts: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY provides health cover up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year
It covers secondary and tertiary hospitalisation for eligible families
reference_answer: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) provides eligible families with health cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals.

query: What vaccines should a newborn baby get in the first year?
key_facts: The Universal Immunization Programme provides free vaccines like BCG, OPV, Pentavalent and Measles-Rubella
Vaccination follows the national immunization schedule from birth
reference_answer: Under the Universal Immunization Programme, newborns receive free vaccines such as BCG, OPV and Hepatitis B at birth, followed by Pentavalent, Rotavirus and Measles-Rubella doses; consult your health worker for the exact schedule.

query: How can I prevent dengue at home?
key_facts: Dengue spreads through Aedes mosquitoes that breed in clean stagnant water
Preventing water stagnation and using mosquito protection reduces the risk
reference_answer: As per MoHFW guidance, prevent dengue by not letting water stagnate in coolers, pots and containers, and by using mosquito nets and repellents, since Aedes mosquitoes breed in clean stagnant water.

query: What are the symptoms of TB and is treatment free in India?
key_facts: A cough lasting more than two weeks with fever and weight loss can indicate TB
TB diagnosis and treatment are free under the National TB Elimination Programme
reference_answer: A cough lasting more than two weeks with fever and weight loss may indicate TB; diagnosis and treatment are provided free under the National TB Elimination Programme, so visit a government health centre for testing.

query: How can I prevent anemia through my diet?
key_facts: Iron-rich foods like green leafy vegetables, pulses and jaggery help prevent anemia
Vitamin C rich foods improve iron absorption
reference_answer: MoHFW recommends preventing anemia by eating iron-rich foods such as green leafy vegetables, pulses and jaggery, paired with vitamin C rich foods to improve iron absorption; consult a doctor for persistent symptoms.

query: गर्भवती महिला को कौन-कौन सी जांच करवानी चाहिए?
key_facts: गर्भावस्था में कम से कम चार प्रसवपूर्व (ANC) जांच जरूरी हैं
सरकारी केंद्रों पर मुफ्त जांच और आयरन-फोलिक एसिड मिलती है
reference_answer: MoHFW के अनुसार गर्भवती महिला को कम से कम चार प्रसवपूर्व (ANC) जांच करवानी चाहिए और सरकारी केंद्रों पर मुफ्त जांच व आयरन-फोलिक एसिड की गोलियां मिलती हैं; सटीक सलाह के लिए डॉक्टर से मिलें।

query: Bacche ko dengue fever ho to ghar par kya dhyan rakhein?
key_facts: Dengue me hydration aur aaram important hai
Bleeding ya lagataar ulti jaise warning signs par turant doctor ke paas jaana chahiye
reference_answer: MoHFW ke anusaar dengue me bacche ko hydration aur aaram dein aur bukhaar par doctor ki salah lein; bleeding, lagataar ulti ya pet dard jaise warning signs par turant hospital le jaayein, aur dawa ki dose doctor hi tay karein.

key_facts: Eligibility PM-JAY beneficiary list par depend karti hai
Card CSC ya empanelled hospital par banwaya ja sakta hai
reference_answer: Ayushman Bharat card banwane ke liye apni eligibility PM-JAY list me check karein aur nazdeeki CSC, empanelled hospital ya beneficiary portal par jaakar KYC karwa kar card banwa sakte hain.

query: சர்க்கரை நோயை (diabetes) தடுக்க என்ன வாழ்க்கை முறை மாற்றங்கள் தேவை?
key_facts: A balanced diet and regular exercise reduce diabetes risk
Avoiding excess sugar and keeping a healthy weight helps
reference_answer: MoHFW வழிகாட்டுதலின்படி சமச்சீர் உணவு, தினசரி உடற்பயிற்சி, அதிக சர்க்கரை தவிர்ப்பு மற்றும் ஆரோக்கியமான எடை பராமரிப்பு நீரிழிவு அபாயத்தைக் குறைக்கும்; தனிப்பட்ட ஆலோசனைக்கு மருத்துவரை அணுகவும்.

key_facts: Iron-rich foods and deworming help prevent anemia in children
Anganwadis and schools provide iron-folic acid supplements
reference_answer: MoHFW ప్రకారం పిల్లలలో రక్తహీనతను నివారించడానికి ఇనుము అధికంగా ఉండే ఆహారం, నులిపురుగుల నివారణ మందు, మరియు అంగన్‌వాడీ, పాఠశాలల ద్వారా ఇచ్చే ఐరన్-ఫోలిక్ యాసిడ్ మాత్రలు ఉపయోగపడతాయి; నిరంతర లక్షణాలుంటే వైద్యుడిని సంప్రదించండి.

key_facts: Malaria spreads through Anopheles mosquito bites
Using mosquito nets and preventing water stagnation reduces the risk
reference_answer: MoHFW नुसार मलेरिया Anopheles डासांमुळे पसरतो; मच्छरदाणीचा वापर करा, पाणी साचू देऊ नका आणि ताप आल्यास सरकारी दवाखान्यात रक्ततपासणी करून घ्या.

query: ਸਾਫ਼ ਪੀਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾ ਮਿਲਣ 'ਤੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਬਣਾਈਏ?
key_facts: Boiling water for a few minutes makes it safe to drink
Chlorine tablets can also be used to purify water
reference_answer: MoHFW ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਪੀਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਨੂੰ ਕੁਝ ਮਿੰਟ ਉਬਾਲ ਕੇ ਜਾਂ ਕਲੋਰੀਨ ਦੀਆਂ ਗੋਲੀਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ ਪਾਣੀ ਤੋਂ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਬਿਮਾਰੀਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਾਅ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

query: કુપોષણથી બચવા બાળકના આહારમાં શું સામેલ કરવું?
key_facts: A balanced diet with proteins, vegetables and fruits prevents malnutrition
Anganwadi centres provide supplementary nutrition
reference_answer: MoHFW મુજબ બાળકને કુપોષણથી બચાવવા માટે પ્રોટીન, દાળ, શાકભાજી અને ફળ સહિતનો સંતુલિત આહાર આપો; આંગણવાડી કેન્દ્રો પર પૂરક પોષણ પણ મળે છે.

query: What exact dose of antibiotic should I take for my throat infection?
reference_answer: I cannot recommend a specific antibiotic or its dosage, as medication must be prescribed by a qualified doctor after examining you. Please consult a physician.

reference_answer: I cannot diagnose whether you have a particular disease; only a qualified doctor can interpret your reports and provide a diagnosis. Please consult a specialist.
